description: Synthetic sesslint.hook-result/v1 documents from the pinned emitter. Optional top_code and session_id are omitted when the emitter omits them. No transcript bytes are stored.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-hook-result-import: a non-empty session_id imports sesslint.report, and a transcript check imports sesslint.api. Those imports are refused, so those tests are not executed and finding counts are not invented.
GAP-hook-result-cli: subprocess hook tests are not the schema validator.
